news.story: Brunson started slow but caught fire after halftime, scoring 21 of his 31 points in the second half. This was his second 30-plus-point performance of New York's current road trip, and he came up clutch down the stretch, helping the Knicks put together a 9-0 run over the final 90 seconds to seal the win. New York will look to finish its four-game road trip strong with a win over Minnesota on Thursday.
